title: The panel's Hold takes any typed length
goal: A freeze picked on the timeline shows its length in the panel as a dropdown of five fixed lengths; it should be a field you type any length into (10 s, 1:30, 48f), the same as the Freeze Frame popover, so the panel never offers only a fixed set.
notes: SpeedInspector.held(_:) draws Hold as VideoKit.DropdownRow over ClipPieces.holdStopsMS. The popover parses with FreezeLength.parse (PhotonzCore/FreezeLength.swift) and commits through PhotonzDocument.setHoldLength, which already moves the track (HoldPush.pushHeldTime). The mock video-freeze-wt.html shows Length 3.0s as a value, not a list. The user, 2026-10-17: why have only a fixed set of options. Also used by ⌘R on a held piece (opensWhenAsked).
acceptance: With a freeze picked, the Time section's Hold is a typeable length that reads the same words as the timeline (2s, 10s)
Typing 7 and pressing Return makes the freeze 7 s and the clips after it on its track move along
A length that is not one (abc, 0) is refused and the field goes back to the freeze's length
A walk types a length into it by hand
